description: React component for the Home page of a silent auction platform, allowing users to create or join auctions, with form handling and navigation.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new auction event, including form validation, calling createEvent and sendHostMagicLink, and updating UI state.

methods.name: handleJoin
methods.description: Handles joining an existing auction by event code, including validation and navigation.
